3691e57328.q: Why is optionality a key concept for exit planning advisors to emphasize with business owners?
3691e57328.a: Optionality means a valuable business has multiple paths forward—holding the business, bringing in strategic investors, dividend recaps, selling outright, partnering, or selling a majority interest. Future exits aren't single transactions but multiple bites of the apple with hybrid exit structures. This allows business owners to execute exit options whenever they want and negotiate better terms, as demonstrated by younger owners who rolled proceeds into deals to maintain upside potential.
